audit.why: 56.8% over 3843 games backs FAVOURED 4/10 and an all-Galio chart. Akali must physically arrive to do damage, and arriving is exactly what Justice Punch and Shield of Durand punish. No rows moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] claimed Galio has 'passive shred' — he does not — and missed the real late-game variable, Perfect Execution's health threshold.
audit.why: Galio's passive is bonus magic damage in an area with an auto-attack reset; there is no shred in the kit. Akali's R carries the execute flag.
audit.corrected: Rewrote around the execute threshold instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields called Akali's ultimate 'Shadow Dance' — that is the retired name. It is Perfect Execution. The page also never stated that Justice Punch's knockup denies Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution.
audit.why: Both dashes are the only ways Akali closes; a knockup on the arrival is the matchup's decisive interaction and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Fixed the name in whys[5] and spikes[1]; stated the dash denial in the trading and Don'ts fields.
sources: enemyKit E and R dash flags

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; dosFull[2].d called Twilight Shroud a 'fifteen-second' window.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 — fifteen seconds is wrong at every rank.
audit.corrected: Shroud 20s at rank 1, Shuriken Flip 16s at rank 1, Justice Punch 11s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shuriken Flip's two-stage cast (mark, then re-cast to dash) was never mentioned, so the Don't about feinting had no mechanism.
audit.why: The taunt should be released on the re-cast, not the flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twelve lint findings: seven misgenderings, two copy-paste bleeds, one no-digit cooldowns field.
audit.corrected: All folded into the edits below.

edits.before: Akali wins by landing Twilight Shroud, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Akali wins by reaching you: Shuriken Flip in, shroud to break your taunt lock, then Perfect Execution once you are under the threshold.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-knockup when she Shuriken Flips in, W-taunt the commit — her dash is the tell, not the smoke.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Charging W into the shroud — she is untargetable inside and simply walks out of your 275 range while the statue stands there free to hit.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield. Bad trade: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-knockup when she Shuriken Flips in, W-taunt the commit — her dash is the tell. Bad trade: charging W into the shroud — she is untargetable inside and walks out of your 275 range while the statue is free to hit.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield. Great trade: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud — commit immediately. Bad trade: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-knockup when she Shuriken Flips in, W-taunt the commit — her dash is the tell. Great trade: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud on nothing — commit immediately. Bad trade: charging W into the shroud — she is untargetable inside and walks out of your 275 range while the statue is free to hit.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Shield of Durand for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 — she is untargetable inside, so hold taunt and Q for the moment she attacks or exits. - Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1; with it down she has no way into you and no way out.

edits.before: Q the disengage he takes after
edits.after: Q the smoke she disappears into

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Q is not a targeted spell — the tornado ticks on whoever is standing in the shroud, so throw it onto the smoke and she has to leave early.

edits.before: Akali burns Twilight Shroud on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Akali burns Twilight Shroud on nothing — that is a 20-second invitation at rank 1.

edits.before: That’s Akali’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Her E marks first and only then dashes — taunt the re-cast, not the flip.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and your only answer to Shuriken Flip — roaming without it hands her the wave and the return trip.

edits.before: Ahead, tax both maps: zone Akali with taunt threat, keep the wave middle, and R every skirmish — fed Galio makes the enemy jungler unemployed.
edits.after: Ahead, hold the ground: Akali needs Shuriken Flip (16s) to reach you, so stand where she must dash into your E, and R every skirmish she leaves for.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by arriving: R shields the ally first, then knocks up — drop it on whoever she jumped and her execute cast finds a shield.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Hollow Radiance or Riftmaker-tank lines, Mercs, then Abyssal Mask and Zhonya's — MR is your damage. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Hollow Radiance or Riftmaker-tank lines, Mercs, then Abyssal Mask and Zhonya's — MR is your damage. Zhonya's answers her execute cast.

edits.before: Commit on Twilight Shroud’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Twilight Shroud's 20s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler's setup. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Level 6: Galio's map-wide ultimate outvalues her Shadow Dance for global pressure.
edits.after: Level 6: Galio's map-wide ultimate outvalues Perfect Execution, which is 675 range.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance lets you answer any Shadow Dance roam she takes onto your team, turning her split-map play into a liability.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance lets you answer any roam she takes onto your team — Perfect Execution moves her 675 units, yours crosses the map.

edits.before: A tank item makes you nearly immune to her burst combo, and your passive shred means she can't just Shroud-reset to finish you.
edits.after: A tank item blunts her burst, and Perfect Execution kills on a health threshold — stay above it and her second cast finishes nothing.

notes: "Shadow Dance" appeared twice in the content layer as Akali's ultimate; the real name is Perfect Execution (packet.enemyAbilities agrees) and both are fixed here. dosFull[2].d asserted a fifteen-second Shroud, which is wrong at every rank (20/19/18/17/16). Level chart is all-Galio on both layers, agrees with the packet and with a 56.8% win rate, so nothing was moved. wants.you[1] says Q poke 'doesn't require vision' — plausible for a ground-targeted tornado but not stated anywhere in Riot's text, so I left it and am recording it as unverified rather than asserting it.
